hook.en: From rainfall in July, can a farmer estimate the yield in November? Regression fits the best straight line to past data and uses it to predict.

objectives.en: Explain the method of least squares
Write the regression lines of y on x and of x on y

narration.en: From rainfall in July, can a farmer estimate the yield in November? Regression fits the best straight line to past data and uses it to predict.

body.en: The regression line of y on x minimises the sum of squared vertical distances of the points from the line (least squares): $y - \bar y = b_{yx}(x - \bar x)$ with $b_{yx} = \dfrac{\sum dx\,dy}{\sum dx^2} = r\,\dfrac{\sigma_y}{\sigma_x}$. The line of x on y minimises horizontal distances: $x - \bar x = b_{xy}(y - \bar y)$, $b_{xy} = r\,\sigma_x/\sigma_y$. Use y on x to estimate y for a given x, and x on y to estimate x. Both pass through $(\bar x, \bar y)$.
